record.paper_title: Optimal Algorithms for Numerical Integration: Recent Results and Open Problems
record.context_brief: Conjectured lower bound for an orthogonally invariant C2 class
record.original_question: Let C_tilde^2(D_d) be the class of twice continuously differentiable functions f on an open set D_d subset R^d with volume 1 such that ||f||_infty <= 1, Lip(f) <= d^(-1/2), and every directional derivative D^Theta f satisfies Lip(D^Theta f) <= d^(-1) for all directions Theta on the unit sphere. Does there exist a constant C>0, independent of d and of the domain D_d, such that the worst-case integration error always satisfies e(n,C_tilde^2(D_d)) >= C n^(-2/d)?

evidence.quote: Example 1. Let us discuss the integration problem for the class C~2(Dd) = { f \u2208 C2(Dd) | ||f||infty <= 1, Lip(f) <= d-1/2, Lip(DTheta f) <= d-1 }, as in [45, 46, 48].
We conjecture that there exists a constant C > 0 (independent on d and Dd) such that e(n,C~2(Dd)) >= C \u00b7 n-2/d.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
For an integer $d\ge 1$, let $D_d\subset \mathbb{R}^d$ be an open set of Lebesgue volume $1$. Define the class
$$\widetilde{C}^{\,2}(D_d)=\Bigl\{\,f\in C^2(D_d)\ \Big|\ \|f\|_\infty\le 1,\ \mathrm{Lip}(f)\le d^{-1/2},\ \mathrm{Lip}(D_\Theta f)\le d^{-1}\ \text{for every unit vector }\Theta\in S^{d-1}\,\Bigr\},$$
where $D_\Theta f$ denotes the directional derivative of $f$ in direction $\Theta$ and $\mathrm{Lip}(g)$ is the (smallest) Lipschitz constant of $g$ on $D_d$.

For $n\in\mathbb{N}$, the (deterministic) worst-case integration error using at most $n$ function evaluations is
$$e(n,\widetilde{C}^{\,2}(D_d))=\inf_{\substack{x_1,\dots,x_n\in D_d\\ \phi:\mathbb{R}^n\to\mathbb{R}}}\ \sup_{f\in \widetilde{C}^{\,2}(D_d)}\ \Bigl|\,\int_{D_d} f(x)\,dx-\phi(f(x_1),\dots,f(x_n))\,\Bigr|.$$

Decide whether there exists an absolute constant $C>0$, independent of both the dimension $d$ and the domain $D_d$, such that
$$e\bigl(n,\widetilde{C}^{\,2}(D_d)\bigr)\ \ge\ C\,n^{-2/d}\qquad \text{for all }n\in\mathbb{N},\ d\in\mathbb{N},\ \text{and all admissible }D_d.$$
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is stated explicitly as a conjecture in a recent survey on optimal algorithms for numerical integration. Related literature (Hinrichs, Krieg, Novak, and collaborators) develops Hilbert-space and Schur-product techniques for lower bounds for integration, but no source appears to establish the conjectured dimension-uniform $n^{-2/d}$ lower bound for the orthogonally invariant $\widetilde{C}^{\,2}(D_d)$ class. No resolution has been located.
